title: Best Class Booking System Review: Features, Limits & Value | SMMcalc.com

facts.fact: GoHighLevel offers a 14-day free trial with full access to the Unlimited plan features, according to the vendor-affiliated review page.
facts.quote: GoHighLevel gives you a 14-day free trial with full access to the Unlimited plan features [[5]].

facts.fact: GoHighLevel's Starter plan starts at $97 per month and includes three sub-accounts and all core features.
facts.quote: GoHighLevel starts at $97 per month for the Starter plan, which includes three sub-accounts and all core features [[5]].

facts.fact: GoHighLevel's Unlimited plan costs $297 per month and removes the sub-account limit.
facts.quote: The Unlimited plan costs $297 per month and removes the sub-account limit, making it ideal if you manage multiple studios or coach other instructors.

facts.fact: GoHighLevel's Founder plan costs $497 per month and adds rebilling features and partner network access.
facts.quote: There is also a Founder plan at $497 per month that adds exclusive rebilling features and partner network access.

facts.fact: The review states that GoHighLevel's automation workflows can send SMS reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before a class starts; this describes platform capability, not a measured result.
facts.quote: You can set up automatic SMS reminders 24 hours and 2 hours before the class starts.

facts.fact: The review page is published on 2026-11-03 according to its metadata.
GoHighLevel offers a 14-day trial, which the page recommends for building and testing a class booking workflow.
facts.quote: the 14-day trial is the perfect place to build your workflow.

facts.fact: During the GoHighLevel trial, users get full access to the Unlimited plan features, according to the page.
facts.quote: You get full access to the Unlimited plan features during the trial.

facts.fact: The page's author states that the initial GoHighLevel setup takes a few hours.
facts.quote: The initial setup takes a few hours, but the long-term time savings are massive.

facts.fact: According to the page, GoHighLevel's calendar setup asks for class name, duration, seat capacity, and payment amount in a visual interface.
facts.quote: define the class name, duration, seat capacity, and payment amount.
